question: Estimate the size of the Indian green hydrogen opportunity by 2030.
idealClarificationQuestions: Green hydrogen production capacity + market value by 2030? Yes.
Per National Green Hydrogen Mission targets? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: National Green Hydrogen Mission target: 5 MMT (million tonnes) annual production by 2030.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Production value: 5,000,000 tonnes × 1000 kg × $3.75 = $18.75B = ~₹1.6 lakh Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Reality check: hitting 5 MMT by 2030 is aggressive; realistic 2-3 MMT = ₹70K-1.2 lakh Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: hitting 5 MMT by 2030 is aggressive; realistic 2-3 MMT = ₹70K-1.2 lakh Cr.

calculationFlow: National Green Hydrogen Mission target: 5 MMT (million tonnes) annual production by 2030.
Production value: 5,000,000 tonnes × 1000 kg × $3.75 = $18.75B = ~₹1.6 lakh Cr.
Plus electrolyzer manufacturing + supporting infra: ~₹40,000 Cr.
Total green hydrogen ecosystem: ~₹2 lakh Cr opportunity by 2030.
Reality check: hitting 5 MMT by 2030 is aggressive; realistic 2-3 MMT = ₹70K-1.2 lakh Cr.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Reality check: hitting 5 MMT by 2030 is aggressive; realistic 2-3 MMT = ₹70K-1.2 lakh Cr.
